personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 4 Tactile/Playful button styling (Gaming)
personality_one_liner: A high-energy, high-contrast arcade runner with chunky tactile buttons, dark navy panels, and vibrant electric blue/gold accents.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for chunky game UI. Use lg/xl padding for panels to accommodate 3D buttons.

do's: Use on in-game HUD panels (score, coins) so the game world remains visible behind them
Use on Pause menu and Game Over overlays for a premium arcade feel
dont's: Do not use on primary 3D buttons
Do not use on low-end Android targets (fallback to solid surfaceSecondary)

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Branding handoff from Velactra to Rush Rivals with loading progress.

states.loading: Shows logo with an animated progress bar
states.error: Error panel with Retry if initialization fails

screens.layout: Center Velactra logo -> crossfade to Rush Rivals logo -> bottom anchored loading bar.

screens.name: MainMenu
screens.purpose: Primary hub for the player to view stats, configure settings, and start the run.
screens.layout: Top zone: Player name 'Player', coin balance, best score. Center stage: City background and runner Rush. Lower-half thumb zone: Large gold PLAY button. Bottom zone: Settings toggles (sound, vibration, accessibility). Android back triggers Exit ConfirmationDialog.

screens.name: Run
screens.purpose: The core gameplay loop rendered via Skia with an overlaid HUD.
screens.layout: Full-screen Skia canvas. Top HUD: Left-aligned score/distance, Right-aligned pause button and coins. HUD panels use glassmorphism to show gameplay underneath.

screens.name: PauseMenu
screens.purpose: Interrupt the game safely, allowing the user to resume, restart, or quit.
screens.layout: Centered modal card over overlayScrim. Large title. Stacked electric blue PrimaryButtons for Resume, Restart, Home. Confirmations stacked recursively.

screens.name: GameOver
screens.purpose: Celebrate the run, summarize rewards, and funnel back into gameplay.
screens.layout: Centered large card. Top: 'New Best!' badge if applicable. Middle: Large Score display, Distance, Coins Earned. Bottom: Side-by-side or stacked Gold 'Play Again' and Blue 'Home' buttons.

runner_rush.alt: Runner character Rush in red hoodie

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's explicit request: use Dark Navy panels, Electric Blue primary buttons, and Gold for the PLAY button and coins.
Override the default 'no blue' rule since it was explicitly requested by the user in the problem statement.

Button Styling (Critical for Game UI): Implement PrimaryButton as a chunky 3D button. Use a container with a solid background and a darker bottom border (e.g., borderBottomWidth: 6) to create a 'lip' shadow. Use react-native-reanimated to scale the button down to 0.93 on press, simultaneously reducing the bottom border thickness to simulate pressing into the screen.

Typography: Use Lilita One (loaded via expo-font with local TTF, NOT @expo-google-fonts) for all display text (Score, Main Titles, Countdown, Button labels). Use Nunito for body text and smaller stats.

Layout Hierarchy: As discovered during research, keep the Main Menu strictly separated into zones: Player status (top), thematic character/background (center), large thumb-accessible PLAY button (bottom-center), and settings (bottom edge).
Images: For the MVP build, replace the Unsplash placeholders in this JSON with the 'already generated art' local assets mentioned in the prompt (e.g., require('../assets/rush-logo.png')).
Ensure all touch targets are strictly >= 48dp as requested for gaming accessibility.
Error Handling: The ToastMessage should be used for 'Save data was reset' and ErrorPanel with Retry should be used on the Splash screen if init fails.
No dead buttons. Do not implement UI for a shop, character selection, or missions. Only build the toggles and buttons explicitly mentioned.
